window_start.description: Start of the registered window (part of the aggregate's identity; exact key).

window_end.description: End of the registered window (exclusive; part of the aggregate's identity).

constraint_type.description: The documented constraint types. The service does not validate the value; any string is stored and echoed back.

unit.description: The documented capacity units. The service does not validate the value on registration: the first constraint fixes the aggregate's native unit (whatever string it is) and a later constraint in another unit is 409 unit-mismatch.
